verses.text: Ha tiknaik, tzin tz'ib'ejb'at t'ayex chajtil ol aj sjawi Kajal Jesucristo, haton yik ol onh molchajoch yet'ok. Tzin tewib'at t'ayex to

max he komon ak'ej somchajel he pensar tato ay heb' tz'alan t'ayex to janakxo sk'ual Kajal chi'. Wach'chom syal heb' to a Yespíritu Dios ix ch'oxan t'a heb', ma munil syal heb' t'a yol yiko', palta manh ex och ilk'olal yuj heb'. Taxonhej syal heb' to ix k'och ko karta t'a heb', palta manh he cha eyab'i.

Manh eyak' musansatil he b'a, yujto ayik manto ja jun k'ual chi', tzijtum mach ol meltzaj pax och ajk'olal t'a Dios. Hato ta' ol cheklajel winh yajalil chukal. Ha winh chi', yowalil ol ak'jokkanb'at winh t'a syaelal.

Ha jun winh chi' ol yak' owal winh yet' Dios. Ol chichon sk'ool winh t'a jantaknhej komon Dios yet' t'a jantaknhej tas b'aj syal sb'a heb' anima. Ol em wal k'ojan winh t'a yol stemplo Dios, ol yalanoch sb'a winh Diosal.
Naekkoti to ix walkan juntzanh tik t'ayex ayik ay in ek' eyet' ta'.
Eyojtak tas tzato kachanoch waan winh yik max cheklajelta winh. Palta hato yik ol jawok stiempoal, hato ta' ol cheklajelta winh.
Ha tiknaik, a chukal wanxo smunlaj t'a elk'altak masanto ol ik'jok el jun mach skachanoch waan sch'oxk'ab'an sb'a chi'.

Hato wal ta' ol cheklajkanel jun winh yajal chukal chi'. Palta ayik ol jawok Kajal Jesús ol spukham winh yajal chukal chi' yet' yik', haxo stzikikial ol ik'an satkanel winh. Palta ayik manto satel winh chi', a tik ol sk'ulej winh:

Ayik ol cheklajel winh ol yak'och sb'a winh Satanás yet' winh. Ol yak'och spoder winh t'a winh. Yuj chi' ol yal sb'oan juntzanh milagro winh yet' juntzanhxo tas ol ch'oxanel spoder, palta es juntzanh chi'.

Tzijtum tas malaj swach'il ol sk'ulok winh, yik ol yak' musansatil heb' anima satnak winh. Ol satkanel heb', yujto malaj snib'ej heb' syak'och jun k'ayb'ub'al te yel tik t'a sk'ool yik skolchajel heb'.
Yuj chi', ha Dios ol chaan ak'jok musansatil heb', yik ol yak'och jun es chi' heb' t'a sk'ool.
Yuj chi' a jantaknhej heb' maj ak'anoch jun k'ayb'ub'al te yel tik t'a sk'ool, ol ak'jokkanb'at heb' t'a syaelal, yujto ix k'echaanh heb' yet' chukal.

Ex xajanab'il yuj Kajal Jesús, yowalil skak'nhej yuj diosal t'a Dios eyuuj, yujto sik'b'il ex taxonkanel yuj Dios chi' ket'ok t'a yichb'anel, yik tzex kolchaj yuj Yespíritu. Ha tzex ak'anoch yikok Dios. Yuj chi' tzex kolchaj ket'ok, yujto tzeyak'och jun k'ayb'ub'al te yel tik t'a he k'ool.
Yuj jun wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il ek' kalnak t'ayex, ha Dios awtannak ex och yikok, yik wach' ay eyalan heyik t'a sniwanil yelk'och Kajal Jesucristo ket'ok.
Yuj chi', tek'an wal tzeyutej he b'a. Manh eyak' sat he k'ool t'a juntzanh k'ayb'ub'al ek' kalnakkan t'ayex yet' juntzanhxo ko tz'ib'ejnakb'at t'ayex.
Tzonh xajanej Kajal Jesucristo yet' ko Mam Dios. Syak' sniwanil ko k'ool t'a masanil tiempo yuj swach'k'olal. Syak'anpax kak'och swach'il yipok ko k'ool.
Ko gana a swach' ak'an tzalajk'olal t'ayex. Syak'anpax he tek'anil yik wach' a jantaknhej tas tzeyala', tze k'ulej, wach'nhej t'a yichanh.
